project_context.vibe: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day, Michelin-star restaurant, High-end hospitality, Luxury, Image-first, Minimal, Timeless
project_context.objective: Build trust through visual WOW factor, drive immediate Call/WhatsApp conversions.

colors.rules: White is the dominant color (80%). Soft warm beige is used for section breaks (15%). Champagne gold is strictly an accent (5%) never overused. Black for maximum typographic contrast.

headings.style: Elegant, large scale, tight tracking for large text, high contrast.

body.style: Clean, highly readable, generous line height (leading-relaxed).

grids_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Let the photography breathe.
grids_and_spacing.bento_rules: Avoid rigid symmetrical grids. Use asymmetrical 12-column grids or overlapping offsets for image curation.

navigation.style: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with 1px delicate bottom border (border-black/5).
navigation.links: Home, About, Services, Signature Dishes, Live Counters, Gallery, Testimonials, Contact.
navigation.cta: Subtle Call/WhatsApp text links in nav, Instagram icon.

hero.style: Kinetic full-screen hero. Dark/cinematic image with bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast.
hero.animation: Signature on-load moment: Masked line-by-line reveal of the headline using Framer Motion (staggered overflow-hidden containers).
hero.content: Large Playfair Display headline (e.g., 'The Art of Fine Catering'), small Inter subheading. ONLY two CTAs: Call and WhatsApp (elegant pill buttons, one filled champagne gold, one outlined white). NO 'Get Quote' buttons.

about_manifesto.style: Numbered manifesto chapters. High editorial contrast. Large typography.
about_manifesto.layout: Sticky left column with chapter number (e.g., '01', '02' in large Playfair Display), right column scrolling content. Parallax image reveals.

services.layout: Asymmetrical grid or horizontal scroll. Cards feature a large clipped frame image, a title (e.g., 'Wedding Catering'), and a short 1-sentence description.
services.hover: Image scales up slowly (scale-105 transition-transform duration-700), text shifts slightly.

signature_dishes.style: Premium food presentation. Large spotlight imagery.
signature_dishes.layout: Alternating left-right image/text layout with massive negative space. Images have organic or sharp clipped edges.

live_counters.style: Immersive showcase. Full bleed or wide aspect ratio images.
live_counters.layout: Editorial carousel or parallax scroll section showcasing the setup.

gallery.style: The strongest section. Luxury photography portfolio.
gallery.layout: Masonry/editorial grid. Mix of large, tall, and wide images.
gallery.features: Category filters (All, Weddings, Corporate, Plating) with smooth layout animations (Framer Motion layout prop). Lightbox on click. Lazy loading for performance.

testimonials.layout: Simple 1-3 column grid or slow fading carousel. Use soft warm beige (bg-[#F9F6F0]) for the section background to contrast with the white site.

contact.layout: Two owner contact cards (Vivek Chawla, Jatin Chawla) with their roles and direct numbers. Google Maps embed (Amritsar, Punjab), Business hours, Instagram link.
contact.design: Clean, structured, un-cluttered. Black and white aesthetic.

floating_buttons.design: Full text buttons: 'Call' and 'WhatsApp'. NOT icon-only. Pill-shaped (rounded-full), distinct colors (e.g., WhatsApp green #25D366 or elegant black/gold, but keep text legible). Stacked or side-by-side with backdrop blur.

editorial_marquee.content: Words like 'Luxury Catering • Michelin-Star Quality • Exquisite Flavors • Unforgettable Events'.
editorial_marquee.design: Pale warm beige background, dark text, Playfair Display italic, massive gaps (gap-32), very slow drift.

admin_panel.style: Headless CMS interface. Clean, utilitarian, Shadcn UI dense dashboard.
admin_panel.features: Sidebar navigation (Pages, Sections, Settings). Forms to edit logo, colors, fonts, hero, services, gallery, dishes, counters, testimonials, contact. Drag-and-drop or simple up/down arrows to change section order. Toggle switches to show/hide sections.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_behavior: Mandatory: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It makes the site feel premium and heavy.
motion_and_interactions.reveal_animations: Use Framer Motion for section scroll-reveals (fade up, slow y-translate).
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Image hover zooms (duration-700 ease-out), button magnetic pulls or subtle background fill sweeps.
motion_and_interactions.hero_3d_parallax: One subtle parallax moment on the hero image (using Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform) to create cinematic depth as the user scrolls down.

hero_images.description: Chef preparing food under warm lighting. Dark and cinematic.

signature_dishes.description: Exquisite Michelin-style plating on white ceramic.
Action shot of chef pouring sauce.

services_and_live_counters.description: Table with abundant, styled food setup.
Chef setting up multiple plates in a high-end kitchen.

instructions: DO NOT create generic 'Bootstrap-style' columns. Use overlapping layers, asymmetrical grids, and high negative space to simulate an editorial magazine.
The 'Gallery' is the centerpiece of the site. It MUST include category filters, lazy loading, a masonry/bento grid, and a lightbox implementation.
The Hero must be fully kinetic with a masked line-by-line reveal on load.
Implement a continuous editorial marquee using Framer Motion or react-fast-marquee.
Floating buttons MUST contain text ('Call', 'WhatsApp') and remain visible at all times. Z-index must be high (z-50).
Admin panel must be separated visually (standard Shadcn dark/light dashboard) from the main consumer site (luxury custom frontend).
Do NOT add any booking, pricing, or package features. The only conversions are Call and WhatsApp.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the navigation header. Use backdrop-blur and semi-transparent white.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use .js files for frontend implementation as per constraints. Do NOT use .tsx files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: Add data-testid to all forms, links, buttons, and navigation elements.
